sin.name: csharp-inline-throw
sin.description: a `?? throw` inside a call's argument or in front of a member call — the check that stops the method is hidden in the middle of the work
sin.rule: Check at the top and throw there; don't hide a `?? throw` inside the expression that does the work.
sin.suggestion: Pull it out into its own line first — `var given = name ?? throw new …;` or an `is null` check with a throw — then do the work with the checked value.
